competences.description: Attacks with the Monkey Wand and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 35% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies and stuns them for 1 turn with a 75% chance. Increases your Attack Bar by 25% per stunned enemy after the attack.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies with the damage that increases according to your MAX HP and puts them to sleep for 1 turn and decreases the Attack Speed for 2 turns with an 80% chance each. In addition, decreases the target's Attack Bar by 30% per harmful effect granted on each enemy.

effets.description: The target will be put to sleep and won't be able to attack. The sleeping target wakes up when attacked or damaged. In addition, you won't receive glancing Hits when you are attacked.
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

effets.note: Per harmful effect applied by this skill
